action.question: Where should I edit the manager skill?

questions.question: Where should I edit the manager skill?

options.label: Vendor into repo, then symlink (Recommended)
options.description: Move SKILL.md into ai-harness/skills/manage/ and symlink it from ~/.claude/skills/manage/, matching the project_skills_vendored convention. Edits go in the repo so they're tracked + portable.

options.label: Edit ~/.claude directly
options.description: Edit the live file in-place. Faster, but the change isn't tracked in the repo and won't sync to your other host.

questions.question: Where should the manager drop visual aids in iCloud?

options.label: ~/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/claude-manager/ (Recommended)
options.description: New top-level iCloud Drive folder for manager artifacts (plan sketches, MVP screenshots, mermaid renders, etc.). Auto-syncs to phone via Files app.

options.label: ~/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/ai-harness/manager/
options.description: Scoped under an ai-harness/ subfolder so future repos can have sibling folders without colliding.

options.label: Let me name it later
options.description: I'll write the skill against a placeholder env var (e.g. CLAUDE_MANAGER_ICLOUD_DIR) so you can point it anywhere later.

questions.question: How far should the autonomy shift go?

options.label: Bias toward action, checkpoint via artifact (Recommended)
options.description: Manager picks reasonable defaults for the plan + worker briefs, executes, and surfaces a CHECKPOINT artifact (plan visual, MVP screenshot, deliverable) for boss to redirect. Still confirms before destructive/irreversible steps (merges, sending workers to close-work). Drops the 'confirm the brief verbatim' step in favor of 'surface assumptions in the artifact'.

options.label: Full auto until MVP delivered
options.description: Manager runs plan→dispatch→track→collect with no boss prompts until an MVP/result lands; only then does the boss see and judge. Risk: a misread of the ask burns worker time before correction.

options.label: Keep existing checkpoints, just add visuals
options.description: Don't relax the 'wait for OK' rules — only add the visual-aid expectation. Misses half your ask but is the smallest change.

I read the `/manage` skill (`~/.claude/skills/manage/SKILL.md`, 490 lines). It currently mandates "surface plan as text" + "wait for boss OK before spawning" + "confirm the brief verbatim". Your two asks pull against those rules:

1. **Visual aids for plans** — instead of (or alongside) text, drop a quick visual (diagram/mockup/mermaid/screenshot) the boss can skim. iCloud Drive as the drop spot.
2. **More autonomy + MVP checkpoints** — fewer "may I?" turns, more "here's the MVP / artifact, redirect me if wrong" turns. Plus self-double-check before surfacing.

Two things I want to nail down before editing:

expected.rec_session: Vendor into repo, then symlink (Recommended), suggest a simple directory name inside of iCloud, Bias toward action, checkpoint via artifact (Recommended)
